title: The Poisoned Present
description: 🟢 Beginner • ~15 min • Trivy, Supply Chain, CVE Remediation - The Sleigh Telemetry image has been small and green on the dashboard for years. Nobody rebuilt it, so its base image reached end-of-life and its pins aged past their own patches. Read the Trivy report, bump the base image and the four stale pins, and push until the scan comes back clean.
